text:
You can't lead if you don't speak both languages: business and technology. Many Product Owners feel stuck in the middle, unable to connect what teams build to what the business needs.

The self-paced DASA DevOps Product Owner Certification helps you bridge that gap.
→ Learn to translate strategic goals into clear, actionable priorities
→ Make smarter, value-driven decisions that prove impact
→ Strengthen collaboration with business, development, and operations

Because great Product Owners deliver results that matter.
